name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Vet Clinic for Claude Code: the book and what needs attention, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. The controlled drug register outranks everything.
sections.sql: select reason, label, who, place, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last limit 15

sections.title: Today
sections.sql: select ref, starts_at as at, patient, client as owner, vet, type, reason, state from v_appointments where on_date = current_date and status = 'scheduled' order by starts_at

sections.title: The week ahead
sections.sql: select ref, on_date, starts_at as at, patient, client as owner, vet, type, reason from v_appointments where status = 'scheduled' and on_date between current_date + 1 and current_date + 7 order by on_date, starts_at

sections.title: Recalls due in the next 30 days
sections.note: Overdue first. 'booked' empty means nobody has rung them yet.
sections.sql: select patient, species, client as owner, phone, vaccine, due_on, next_appt_on as booked, state from v_reminders where due_on <= current_date + 30 order by due_on

name: money
title: The money
subtitle: Vet Clinic for Claude Code: what is owed, unbilled and on the shelf, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Owing
sections.sql: select ref, client, patient, issued_on, due_on, round(total_cents / 100.0, 2) as total_nzd, state from v_invoices where status = 'issued' order by due_on

sections.title: Unbilled work
sections.note: Completed consults with charges and no invoice. This is the write-off queue if nobody acts.
sections.sql: select ref, on_date, patient, client as owner, vet, round(value_cents / 100.0, 2) as value_nzd from v_consults where state = 'unbilled' and status = 'completed' order by on_date

sections.title: Billed in the last 28 days, by vet
sections.sql: select name as vet, consults_last_28d as consults, round(billed_last_28d_cents / 100.0, 2) as billed_nzd from v_staff where role = 'vet' and status = 'active' order by billed_last_28d_cents desc

sections.title: Shelf alerts
sections.sql: select code, name, stock_qty as on_hand, unit, reorder_at, batch_no, batch_expires_on, state from v_stock where state <> 'ok' order by state
